Name: JA Socks of Defence
Author: AlexisBloodwood
Description: A project that took much longer than it should have now at the tips of your... toes. These socks are brought to you by the Alamorna Kingdom to allow you to fight your enemies in comfort without losing any of your protective gear; possibly even gaining some! The silk from grub and fly cocoons were weaved into the fabric of these garments to provide an extra soft- battle ready non-boot! Now gear up and get fighting!
